notes:
- New short-form format: Horizontal B-roll. A horizontal 4:3 video with the camera held still on you (it never follows your head), one line of captions low in the picture, and cutaways to your own B-roll on the lines that can be shown. The B-roll is chosen by what each line means, spread across your folders, always sharp, never zoomed, and centred on its subject. No title card or hook box.
- The first time you use it, Revive looks through your B-roll folder once and remembers what is in each clip, so later clips start straight away.
- Captions in Documentary, Movie Captions and Headline always write \"I\" as a capital.
